notes: Paths are written as <base>/<relative path>, where <base> is the case's folder. The input files are the files under <base> (repo/, userhome/ and others). In input.json and in the stored installed_plugins.json, <base> stands for that folder; a runner substitutes its own folder before the call.
`path` values in the expectation are relative to <base>; labels are as v0.4.0 writes them.
